controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by HIP 67522; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of HIP 67522 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of hip-67522's light, as its colour lens measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of HIP 67522's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 67522 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

HIP 67522 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (64, 101, 102) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 166527623, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 19-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
